summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. filed an 8-K reporting a material modification to security holders' rights and amendments to its bylaws as of May 6, 2026. The filing does not involve any merger, acquisition, tender offer, or special situation. Instead, it appears to be a routine corporate governance update regarding rights of preferred and common stock holders. No financial terms, premiums, or deal mechanics are disclosed. As a standard current report concerning security holder rights and charter amendments, this does not qualify as a special situation.
